{{Top}} {{Character |type=Rebel |image=[[File:Leeza-FriendsEverywhere.jpg]] |name=Leeza |homeworld= |birth= |death=[[2 BBY]], [[Ghorman]]"[[Messenger]]" dates the third three episodes of ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' [[Andor Season 2|Season 2]], including the [[death]] of Leeza on [[Ghorman]] in "[[Who Are You?]]," to [[2 BBY]]. |species=[[Human]]{{Andor|I Have Friends Everywhere}} |gender=[[Gender|Female]]{{Andor|I Have Friends Everywhere}} {{AD|Disney+}} |pronouns=She/her{{Andor|Who Are You?}} {{Subtitles|Disney+}} |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Brown]] |feathers= |eyes=Brown |skin=Light |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Empire]] **[[Imperial Bureau of Standards]] *[[Ghorman Front]] |masters= |apprentices= }} '''Leeza''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who resided on [[planet]] [[Ghorman]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. Leeza worked for the [[Imperial Bureau of Standards]]' [[Bureau of Standards Ghorman field office|field office]] in the [[capital]] [[city]] [[Palmo]], but was also a member of the [[Ghorman Front]]. Leeza was [[Death|killed]] during the [[Ghorman Massacre]]. ==Biography== {{Quote|Tell me about the neighborhood.''"
"''Three families here. Another two at the back. Both with children.|Leeza talking to Vel Sartha during the heist planning|}} In [[3 BBY]],{{Andor|Ever Been to Ghorman?}} Leeza worked on [[ghorlectipod]]-related inventories and audits{{Databank|bureau-of-standards-ghorman-field-office|Bureau of Standards Ghorman field office}} at the [[Imperial Bureau of Standards]] [[Bureau of Standards Ghorman field office|field office]] in [[Palmo]], the [[capital]] [[city]] of [[Ghorman]]. Leeza was also a member of the [[Ghorman Front]], a local rebel cell. When an [[Imperial Security Bureau]] sweep was conducted at the office by [[ISB Attendant|Attendant]] [[Grymish]], Leeza was able to signal members of the Front to deactivate a [[listening device]] that the group had installed in the [[Division Chief]]'s office. While the sweep was conducted Leeza and the rest of the employees were directed to leave the office. Following the sweep, they were in the office when [[Syril Karn]], the Division Chief, returned and told the group that the techs had found the listening office and each employee would be given ISB interview before expressing anger over the action by kicking a piece of electronics. Leeza was present during a meeting of the Ghorman Front when [[Vel Sartha]] and [[Cinta Kaz]], two members of [[Axis network|another rebel group]], advised the group on how to accomplish a [[Ghorman heist|heist]] of [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] weapons from an [[Imperial transport carrier]]. During the meeting, Leeza supplied information about the neighborhood where the group was planning to disable the transport carrier. Leeza, however, did not participate in the heist itself.{{Andor|What a Festive Evening}} A year later, Leeza was among the numerous victims of the Ghorman Massacre.{{Andor|Who Are You?}} ==Personality and traits== Leeza was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] with light skin, [[color|brown]] [[eye]]s, and brown [[hair]]. ==Equipment== While working at the Bureau of Standards field office, Leeza wore a brown vest over a white shirt. Within reach of their workstation at the office, Leeza had a button that warned the Ghorman Front to deactivate the listening device placed in Syril Karn's office. ==Behind the scenes== Leeza was portrayed by [[Caroline Vanier]] and appeared in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in the series's fourth episode, "[[Ever Been to Ghorman?]]," which was released on [[Disney+]] on [[April 29]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Ever Been to Ghorman?}} {{1st|"[[I Have Friends Everywhere]]" and "[[What a Festive Evening]]"}} *{{Andor|I Have Friends Everywhere}} *{{Andor|What a Festive Evening}} *{{Andor|Messenger}} *{{Andor|Who Are You?}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=ლიზა }} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial Bureau of Standards employees]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]] [[Category:Members of the Ghorman Front]]
